title: II. Rákóczi Ferenc és a Brezáni kiáltvány (Ferenc Rákóczi II)
grammar: Reasons in the Past: mert and the Past Tense

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain who Ferenc Rákóczi II was and why he issued the Brezán Proclamation.
I can explain why people followed Rákóczi using mert and the past tense.
I can name the motto on the Kuruc flags and Rákóczi's title.
I can use eight new words about Rákóczi's early life and the Brezán Proclamation.
